# Base Image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable, recent environment
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend for package installations
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install dependencies for building LAMMPS and running MPI applications
# - ca-certificates: For secure network communication (e.g., git clone)
# - build-essential, cmake, git: Core tools for compiling C++ projects
# - python3-dev: Python interpreter and headers, required by LAMMPS build system (FIX)
# - libfftw3-dev: FFTW library, a common LAMMPS dependency
# - openmpi-bin, libopenmpi-dev: OpenMPI for parallel execution
# - libgomp1: GNU OpenMP library, explicitly requested
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    ca-certificates \
    build-essential \
    cmake \
    git \
    python3-dev \
    libfftw3-dev \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    libgomp1 && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments
# - Allow running as root, common in containers
# - Enable oversubscribing nodes, useful in Kubernetes/resource-limited environments
# - Disable rsh/ssh as a process launch agent, not applicable in single-container MPI
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_oversubscribe=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_plm_rsh_agent=/bin/false

# Clone, build, and install LAMMPS from source
# This single RUN command improves layer caching and reduces image size
RUN git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/lammps/lammps.git /lammps && \
    cd /lammps && \
    mkdir build && \
    cd build && \
    cmake ../cmake \
        -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr/local \
        -D BUILD_MPI=yes \
        -D BUILD_OMP=yes \
        -D PKG_REAXFF=on \
        -D PKG_MANYBODY=on && \
    make -j"$(nproc)" && \
    # Install the 'lmp' executable to a system location on the PATH
    make install && \
    # Create the application WORKDIR and place example files there
    mkdir -p /app && \
    cp /lammps/examples/reaxff/HNS/* /app/ && \
    # Clean up the source code to reduce final image size
    rm -rf /lammps

# Set the working directory for the container
WORKDIR /app

# Set a default command to run a sample simulation
CMD ["lmp", "-in", "in.hns"]

# This MiniCluster manifest is designed for a test run of a LAMMPS ReaxFF
# simulation on a single AWS CPU instance within a Kubernetes cluster.
# It is configured to be deployed by the Flux Operator.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # Name of the MiniCluster resource.
  name: lammps-reax-test
  # The namespace where the MiniCluster will be deployed.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The number of pods to create for the MiniCluster.
  # Set to 1 to run on a single node as requested.
  size: 1

  # The total number of tasks for the Flux job.
  # Since this is a single-node test, we will run one task.
  tasks: 1

  # Specifies the main container for the Flux job.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax
      # The command to be executed by the application.
      # The Flux Operator automatically wraps this command with `flux run`.
      command: lmp -v x 2 -v y 2 -v z 2 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite
      # This container is a worker, not a custom launcher. The Flux Operator
      # handles the job launch.
      launcher: false

  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Enforce strict schema validation for the CRD.
    strict: true

  # Do not delete the pods after the job completes, allowing for log inspection.
  cleanup: false

# This MiniCluster manifest is configured for a small-scale test run of a
# LAMMPS ReaxFF simulation on a single node, reverting to a pure MPI
# command to avoid previous OpenMP-related errors.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # Name of the MiniCluster resource.
  name: lammps-reax-test
  # The namespace where the MiniCluster will be deployed.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The number of pods to create for the MiniCluster.
  # Set to 1 to run on a single node as requested.
  size: 1

  # The total number of tasks for the Flux job.
  # This matches the MPI decomposition in the command (2*2*2=8).
  tasks: 8

  # Specifies the main container for the Flux job.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax
      # The command for the test run, as specified.
      # This pure MPI command is supported by the container image.
      command: lmp -v x 2 -v y 2 -v z 2 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite
      # This container is a worker, not a custom launcher. The Flux Operator
      # handles the job launch.
      launcher: false

  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Enforce strict schema validation for the CRD.
    strict: true

  # Do not delete the pods after the job completes, allowing for log inspection.
  cleanup: false

# This MiniCluster manifest is configured for a test run of a LAMMPS ReaxFF
# simulation. It includes a fix for a previous ImagePullBackOff error by
# explicitly targeting an ARM-based AWS instance type and specifying the
# corresponding ARM image for the Flux sidecar container.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # Name of the MiniCluster resource.
  name: lammps-reax-test
  # The namespace where the MiniCluster will be deployed.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The number of pods to create for the MiniCluster.
  # Set to 1 to run on a single node as requested.
  size: 1

  # The total number of tasks for the Flux job, matching the MPI grid (2*2*2=8).
  tasks: 8

  # Specifies the main container for the Flux job.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax
      # The command for the test run.
      command: lmp -v x 2 -v y 2 -v z 2 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite
      # This container is a worker, not a custom launcher.
      launcher: false

  # Pod-level specifications to ensure correct scheduling.
  pod:
    # Selects a specific AWS Graviton (ARM) instance type to ensure
    # architecture compatibility and prevent image pull errors.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: "hpc7g.16xlarge"

  # Flux-specific configuration for the ARM architecture.
  flux:
    # Specifies the target architecture for the flux-view container.
    arch: arm
    # Specifies the correct flux-view container image for the ARM architecture.
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9

  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Enforce strict schema validation for the CRD.
    strict: true

  # Do not delete the pods after the job completes, allowing for log inspection.
  cleanup: false
